label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, in the great hall at eighteen on day 1, with two hundred fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns. Innkeeper, freight, builder and baker coordinated supplies, funding, baking and delivery; secretary knowingly helped arrange timing and escort after a confidential explanation. Mayor was told of a hospitality meeting, not the celebration. No evidence neighbour knowingly helped. Secretary's day 1 06:40 reply was heard by mayor but did not name the surprise.
